title: Feature request : Color lines in treatments
symptom: Users do not know what the colors of the lines in the treatments running mode tab mean, and it is suggested to add color coding or an explanation pop-up to avoid repeated questions.
fix: The thread suggests making the color lines consistent with the loop icon (green for closed loop, blue for open loop, grey for pump disconnected, red for loop suspended, dotted line for LGS) and adding a tap pop-up explanation. However, no definitive resolution was implemented.
evidence_quote: I think color line on the top should be the same than loop icon: green for close loop, blue for open loop, grey for pump disconnected, red for loop suspended, dotted line green (or darker green in dark theme) for LGS mode...
